title: Pixel Auto-Encoder: Reconstructing Language Model Activations Through Pixel Art
abstract: arXiv:2611.28822v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Interpreting the high-dimensional internal representations of large language models (LLMs) remains a challenging problem. Recent approaches have explored translating these representations into human-understandable forms, particularly natural language. In this work, we explore the use of images as an alternative target modality for interpreting LLM activations. As a first step toward this goal, we introduce Pixel Auto-Encoder, which converts intermediate LLM activations into $32 \times 32$, 32-color pixel art and reconstructs them for subsequent computation within the model. By encouraging the intermediate representations to resemble predefined concept images, we investigate whether LLM activations can be expressed visually while preserving the model's language capabilities. We find that the model can produce target-aligned images for some concepts, and that replacing pixel representations with concept images can influence next-token pred

translated_title: 像素自编码器：通过像素艺术重建语言模型激活
translated_abstract: 解释大语言模型（LLM）的高维内部表示仍然是一个具有挑战性的问题。最近的方法探索了将这些表示转化为人类可理解的形式，特别是自然语言。在这项工作中，我们探索使用图像作为解释LLM激活的另一种目标模态。作为实现这一目标的第一步，我们提出了像素自编码器，它将LLM的中间激活转换为32×32、32色的像素艺术图像，并重建它们以用于模型内的后续计算。通过鼓励中间表示类似于预定义的概念图像，我们研究了LLM激活是否可以在视觉上进行表达，同时保持模型的语言能力。我们发现该模型可以为某些概念生成与目标对齐的图像，并且用概念图像替换像素表示可以影响下一个词的预测。
tldr: 提出像素自编码器（Pixel Auto-Encoder），将大语言模型的中间激活转换为32×32的32色像素艺术图像，首次证明LLM激活可以通过视觉形式表达并保持语言能力，且用概念图像替换像素表示能够影响下一个词的预测。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Pixel Auto-Encoder, which converts intermediate LLM activations into 32×32 32-color pixel art, demonstrating that LLM activations can be visually expressed while preserving language capabilities, and that replacing pixel representations with concept images can influence next-token prediction.
